result.summary: The page is largely well-composed: header, search bar, category chips, promo banner, carousels and bottom nav all render correctly. The only visual defect is the horizontal category chip row, where a leftover empty chip placeholder is partially visible at the right edge after 'Healthy'; per instructions, edge-clipped carousel items are treated as intended scroll affordances, so no functional defects remain. One minor cosmetic observation: the clipped element at the right edge of the chip row appears to be an empty gray pill with no label, which reads as an unfinished placeholder rather than a real category.

issues.description: The partially visible chip at the right edge of the category filter row (after 'Healthy') shows as a blank gray pill with no text label, unlike every other chip which has a category name.
issues.suggestion: Give the next chip a visible label (e.g. 'Desserts' or 'Chinese') or remove the empty placeholder so the scroll hint shows real content.
